product_overview: YummBU enables Bennett University students to place food orders directly with campus vendors inside the app, while shopkeepers manage incoming orders in real time. Customers can track active orders, cancel unaccepted orders, and review completed order history.
core_goals: Place food orders from eligible shops directly in the app
Track active orders and view real-time order status updates
Cancel an order before it is accepted
Allow shopkeepers to accept, reject, or complete orders
Review past delivered orders in order history

features.name: In-App Order Placement
features.description: Customers place an order from their cart, confirm the purchase, and are taken to the order details view after submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Review cart items and total -> Start the order placement flow -> See the confirmation dialog with shop name and order total -> Confirm the order -> See the cart clear automatically -> Arrive at the order detail view for the new order

features.name: Customer Live Status & Cancellation
features.description: Customers monitor active orders in real time, inspect order progress, and cancel an order before it is accepted.
user_flows: Navigate to /active-orders -> View active orders with live status updates -> Open an order to inspect its details and progress -> Continue viewing status changes as the order updates
Navigate to /active-orders -> Open an order that is still in placed status -> Cancel the order -> See the order removed from the active flow
Navigate to /active-orders -> Open an order that has already been accepted -> Observe that cancellation is unavailable

features.name: Shopkeeper Order Processing
features.description: Shopkeepers manage incoming orders for their shop by accepting, rejecting with a reason, or marking accepted orders as delivered.
user_flows: Navigate to /shopkeeper -> View the active orders stream for the assigned shop -> Open an order card to inspect order details -> Accept the order -> See the order status update to accepted

Navigate to /shopkeeper -> View the active orders stream for the assigned shop -> Open an order card to inspect order details -> Reject the order -> Enter a rejection reason -> Submit the rejection -> See the order status update to rejected
Navigate to /shopkeeper -> View the active orders stream for the assigned shop -> Open an accepted order -> Mark the order as delivered -> See the order status update to delivered
